kg-12Oi.title: Buildings: many mosques
kg-12Oi.summary: Most people are Muslim, so you see lots of mosques across the country.

kg-1351.title: Coverage: overcast and snowy road in the south
kg-1351.summary: A road northwest of Uzgen with overcast skies and lots of snow, with the southern mirror.

kg-1pTi.title: Landscape: more built-up, partly unpaved
kg-1pTi.summary: East of Naryn, hills are close on the south and farther on the north with smaller plains. It is more built up, and the road is unpaved in places. The hills to the south have small amounts of snow.

kg-2DrZ.title: Landscape: sunny, mountains north, lake south
kg-2DrZ.summary: A sunny stretch with mountains to the north and the lake to the south.

kg-2Ewh.title: Plate: red strip
kg-2Ewh.summary: Plates have a red strip on them. Albania has red strips on plates too, and the UAE very rarely.

differs.how: Only very rarely has red strips

kg-2Zlc.title: Coverage: southern mirror, completely overcast
kg-2Zlc.summary: The third biggest city has the southern mirror and totally overcast shots with no gaps in the clouds. To the east there is a slightly snowy hill.

kg-34JI.title: Coverage: very limited, learn the covered roads
kg-34JI.summary: Coverage is very limited, so learning which roads are covered helps a lot.

kg-3dxS.title: Language: Cyrillic with Ө, Ү and Ң
kg-3dxS.summary: The script looks like Russian but adds the letters Ө, Ү and Ң, which Russian does not have.

kg-4fuX.title: Coverage: southern mirror, never fully overcast
kg-4fuX.summary: The second biggest city has the southern mirror, which separates it from the capital. The weather is fairly good with some clouds but never fully overcast.

kg-5TyF.title: Coverage: sunset on a northeast road
kg-5TyF.summary: A road heading slightly northeast, north of the capital, has sunset coverage that makes it easy to recognise.

kg-5vJo.title: Landscape: dried-up reservoir, tall mountains
kg-5vJo.summary: The mostly dried-up part of a big reservoir, seen to the south or north of the road, with tall mountains close on every side. The northern half is more desolate, the south has more plants and buildings.

kg-62fd.title: Landscape: hilly, snowy mountains south
kg-62fd.summary: South of the capital is a bit hilly with snowy Tian Shan mountains to the south. The city has very polluted air, so usually you see smog to the north.

kg-67Zr.title: Landscape: lake and mountains, sandy rocky soil
kg-67Zr.summary: You almost always see the big lake and the Tian Shan mountains here. The soil is sandy and rocky.

kg-6LBj.title: Road: grassy median
kg-6LBj.summary: The start of this divided road has a grassy median, up to the town of Khun-Chi.

kg-7F9z.title: Vegetation: snow and low broad-leaved trees
kg-7F9z.summary: A lot of snow with low broad-leaved trees all around, with the car driving south to north. Very easy to recognise.

kg-7goI.title: Coverage: distinct sunset on the road
kg-7goI.summary: A clear sunset runs through all the coverage from Sokuluk to Kara Balta. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

kg-7lI0.title: Landscape: mountains south, hills north
kg-7lI0.summary: A lot of mountains and hills to the south, only some hills to the north with seemingly nothing behind, though you might spot the lake. There is a lot of sand on the roadsides.

kg-8Juf.title: Vegetation: lots of plants
kg-8Juf.summary: A lot of greenery beside the road and long green and yellow fields behind. The Tian Shan range is usually visible to the north, with big mountains to the south and smaller hills before them.

kg-935k.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-9QxP.title: Road: rocky dirt road high in snowy hills
kg-9QxP.summary: A rocky dirt road high in the snowy hills south of the capital. Some soil has a red tint, the north part only shows snowy hills to the south, and the roadside has red-and-white bollards.

kg-9Vb2.title: Road: unpaved gravel between two hilly ridges
kg-9Vb2.summary: An unpaved gravel road between two hilly ridges. The northern ridge is further away with bigger mountains behind it, and one unique mountain towers above the rest.

kg-9gAY.title: Road: concrete barrier median
kg-9gAY.summary: From there on, concrete barriers divide the road.

kg-9vpL.title: Road: snowy mountains in every direction
kg-9vpL.summary: A side road with snow-covered mountain ranges in every direction and an almost blinding sun to the south. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

kg-A2PE.title: City: taller multi-storey buildings
kg-A2PE.summary: The capital is by far the most developed city, with many tall buildings and fancier houses on the edges. Mountains lie to the south, though hard to see.

kg-AFqz.title: Landscape: river valley with spruce mountains
kg-AFqz.summary: A river valley in a rocky area with spruce-covered mountains and no snow. One of the most distinctive roads in the country.

kg-ALSa.title: Road lines: wide gap as a median
kg-ALSa.summary: Between Khun-Chi and a junction east of Tokmok, the median is just a wide gap between two sets of road lines.

kg-AzjI.title: Pole: colourful yellow, green, white
kg-AzjI.summary: Towns east and west of the capital have poles painted yellow, green, white and sometimes red on top. One town has no red.

kg-BIp5.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-CYYV.title: Landscape: dry valley, hills close on the south
kg-CYYV.summary: West of Naryn, in a dry valley, hills are close to the road on the south side with bigger mountains behind, and a wide plain to the north. Much of the pavement has a salt-and-pepper look.

kg-D7Jq.title: Landscape: very green valley
kg-D7Jq.summary: A valley that is very green for the country, with many trees and bushes, small patches of snow, the Tian Shan mountains to the north and other snowy mountains to the south.

kg-Dx0D.title: Road: gravel in a valley, bushes and grass
kg-Dx0D.summary: An unpaved gravel road in the middle of a river valley with hills to the north close by, filled with bushes, shrubs and grass. The one town has white-and-red fences. It looks like the paved road west of Naryn.

kg-E42x.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-EsCZ.title: Bollard: white with a diagonal black stripe
kg-EsCZ.summary: Simple white bollards with a diagonal black stripe near the top.

kg-Fajq.title: Landscape: orange ridge north, snow south
kg-Fajq.summary: A steep orange ridge to the north and large snow-capped mountains to the south point to Naryn.

kg-Gofr.title: Vegetation: leafy valley, poor unpaved road
kg-Gofr.summary: A valley full of plants with many buildings and fences by the road. Most of the road is unpaved with potholes. Darker clouds to the north, more cloudy with more dead trees near Arkit. The car drives south to north.

kg-HcN3.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-IwHC.title: Landscape: one distinct ridge south
kg-IwHC.summary: A very distinct mountain range always to the south, scattered mountains that do not form a ridge to the north, and a big set of hills to the west.

kg-KAvq.title: Landscape: snow on red soil hills
kg-KAvq.summary: Mountains and hills south of Naryn mix snow with red soil, which is very distinctive.

kg-Kmab.title: Landscape: dry valley, mountains both sides
kg-Kmab.summary: A dry valley with mountains on both sides and barely any plants except low shrubs. The river brings some green. In the southern half you see a slightly snowy ridge to the north.

kg-L1ht.title: Google car: silver car with four roof bars
kg-L1ht.summary: A silver car with four visible roof bars, all Gen 3. No other country with a similar landscape has a similar car.

kg-MVMj.title: Season: winter, bare trees, snow
kg-MVMj.summary: Everything was covered in winter, so trees are mostly bare, the land looks drab and you often see snow.

kg-Ql12.title: Landscape: dry and rocky with one visible ridge
kg-Ql12.summary: A dry, rocky stretch with lots of mountains, and one particular ridge visible from most of it.

kg-QvzN.title: Landscape: big lake, no mountains beyond
kg-QvzN.summary: The biggest lake can often be seen from roads to its north and south. If buildings hide it, a gap with no mountains in that direction is a good clue. Two other big waters, a reservoir and Lake Song-Kul, are also visible from roads.

kg-TQ4c.title: Coverage: slightly snowy, overcast town
kg-TQ4c.summary: A slightly snowy town between Osh and Manas with overcast coverage and the southern mirror.

kg-TQWw.title: Vegetation: farmland and plants in a flat south
kg-TQWw.summary: A southern area with lots of farming and plants by the road. It is mostly flat but the road runs very close to hills, usually north or east. This stretch has the southern dirty mirror.

kg-UCOW.title: Landscape: rocky mountains with trees
kg-UCOW.summary: The next valley is equally dry but the mountains are rockier and have trees. The road has very bad pavement, so you see dust clouds.

kg-Ux5q.title: Road: concrete barriers, hilly, lots of plants
kg-Ux5q.summary: A very hilly landscape with tall grass, trees and bushes. The road uses concrete barriers as guardrails, with cement above the gaps. The car drives southeast to northwest.

kg-V1VN.title: Landscape: reservoir looks like a real lake
kg-V1VN.summary: The reservoir is usually north of the road here and looks like an actual lake. The land is hilly, especially to the south. The road is in better shape than the one south of the big lake.

kg-VN05.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-WjWO.title: Landscape: overcast, tall tree rows, lake south
kg-WjWO.summary: An overcast stretch with mountains to the north, the lake to the south and tall tree rows on both sides of the road.

kg-Wxhl.title: Google car: driving direction on main roads
kg-Wxhl.summary: Knowing which way the car drives on each major road helps narrow your guess.

kg-Xj8m.title: Vegetation: trees still have leaves
kg-Xj8m.summary: In the second biggest city most trees still have leaves, unlike the capital.

kg-ZLuz.title: Google car: mirror shows less road in the south
kg-ZLuz.summary: The car's mirror hints at the region. In the south less of the road shows in the mirror and the car's reflection is more diagonal.

kg-aBOx.title: Google car: small black dot on the mirror
kg-aBOx.summary: A small black dot on the car's mirror points to a specific set of roads, mostly in the north.

kg-bX73.title: Landscape: flat land, range to the south
kg-bX73.summary: Flat land with the Tian Shan range to the south, which looks foggier the further you are. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

kg-cLzH.title: Landscape: river in a valley to the east
kg-cLzH.summary: A river runs in the valley below the road to the east, with hilly green land, low snowy mountains to the north and snow on the hilltops east of the river. This stretch has the southern dirty mirror.

kg-e8Ex.title: Road: remote gravel road in a dry
kg-e8Ex.summary: A remote gravel road through a dry valley with only shrubs despite a river. Many mountains have steep rocky sides. There is snow, more so in the south.

kg-eBnM.title: Landscape: rocky valley with varied plants
kg-eBnM.summary: A road through a very rocky valley with a variety of plants on the mountainsides, some with a little snow, more snow towards the south.

kg-eZI4.title: Landscape: snowy town in the mountains
kg-eZI4.summary: A snowy mountain resort town north of Manas with hills all around and lots of elevation change inside the town. It also has the southern mirror.

kg-eqAn.title: Pole: white bottom with red and yellow stripes
kg-eqAn.summary: Most poles in the western city of Talas are white at the bottom with red and yellow stripes.

kg-fmun.title: Roads: divided roads near the capital
kg-fmun.summary: Divided roads are mostly around the capital, with a major divided highway running east to Balykchy. A few other cities have at least one divided road.

kg-g1EB.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-gMAS.title: Road lines: thinner gap in the median
kg-gMAS.summary: East of that junction, the gap between the road lines gets thinner, up to the junction east of Kemin.

kg-hefH.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-hr14.title: Landscape: very snowy, uncleared slush
kg-hr14.summary: Hills and mountains almost fully covered in snow. Unlike other snowy roads, this one is often covered in uncleared slush. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

kg-iGgZ.title: Landscape: odd mountain with radio masts on top
kg-iGgZ.summary: In the centre of the second biggest city there are unusual mountains with radio masts on top.

kg-iTQ9.title: Landscape: purple-red rocky cliffs
kg-iTQ9.summary: Steep rocky cliffs with a purple or red tint, almost no vegetation apart from grass and shrubs, a small river beside the road, brown metal pylons and curved concrete guardrails. This stretch has the black dot mirror.

kg-inQ0.title: Coverage: snowy northern roads, bright sky
kg-inQ0.summary: The northern roads have lots of snow and a generally bright sky. The south also has snow, but the mirror tells them apart.

kg-k6Cg.title: Landscape: city between snowy mountains, sunny
kg-k6Cg.summary: A sunny city between snow-capped mountains to the north and south, with melting snow on the ground. This is Karakol in the east.

kg-l8qj.title: Landscape: lots of snow, clear road, hilly
kg-l8qj.summary: Plenty of snow all around except on the road. Mostly hilly, with mountains in the northeast and southwest. Most of it has the black dot mirror.

kg-lmVO.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-m7Dk.title: Coverage: distinct sunset west of the canyon
kg-m7Dk.summary: The part west of the Fairytale Canyon has clear sunset coverage.

kg-mPeu.title: Landscape: very dry, small shrubs
kg-mPeu.summary: The road becomes undivided and the land south of Balykchy is extremely dry with mostly small shrubs, unless you are next to a river. Mountains to the north have clouds above them, otherwise it is cloud-free.

kg-mt5a.title: Road: yellow-and-black kerbs on the median
kg-mt5a.summary: A divided road leading to the international airport with yellow-and-black kerbs on a mostly grassy median, some small planted trees and poles with red-and-yellow paint at the bottom. The part west of the airport has more trees.

kg-o27C.title: Kilometre marker: red-and-white triangle pattern
kg-o27C.summary: Kilometre markers with a red-and-white triangle pattern are unique here, though Kazakhstan has similar ones near one town.

differs.how: Only seen near one Kazakh town

kg-oCfL.title: Landscape: spruce-covered snowy mountains
kg-oCfL.summary: Snowy mountains covered with spruce trees on the M-010, with some snow on the roadsides.

kg-oQxZ.title: Landscape: greener, more buildings
kg-oQxZ.summary: Out of the valley it is more vegetated with more buildings and animals on grassy fields. Hilly with bigger mountains north, south and west, and the southern ones are covered in snow.

kg-ojLs.title: Coverage: snow in a city region
kg-ojLs.summary: Urban snow coverage can be found in this part of the capital.

kg-pwbe.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content

kg-qE8L.title: Road: unpaved high road above the clouds
kg-qE8L.summary: The only unpaved road this high up. You can see clouds below in the valleys, rugged peaks, snowy cliffs and spruce trees on many mountains.

kg-qgtB.title: Landscape: rocky cliffs with spruces
kg-qgtB.summary: Mountains with rocky cliffs and spruce trees, more varied trees next to the river, some snowy peaks and mostly blue signposts.

kg-s0B1.title: Landscape: drier west end of the lake
kg-s0B1.summary: The land around the western end of the lake is drier than in the east, and the lake and the southern hills are further from the road.

kg-s7aU.title: Landscape: lake in dry rolling hills
kg-s7aU.summary: The second biggest lake, Song-Kul, is surrounded by dry rolling hills with patches of snow. The only covered road is gravel.

kg-sEhC.title: Landscape: river gorge, large rocky mountains
kg-sEhC.summary: A road through a river gorge with large rocky mountains on both sides, overcast skies, and a big river, the Naryn, usually to the north.

kg-sLJC.title: Vegetation: tall tree rows, snowy mountains
kg-sLJC.summary: A north-south road lined with tall tree rows on both sides, with tall snowy mountains to the north and south. The weather changes around the midpoint.

kg-tIVh.title: Landscape: snow only on the southern hills
kg-tIVh.summary: Further west only the hills to the south have snow. The land is dry, with hills north and south of the road. Most of it has the black dot mirror.

kg-tkk4.title: Google car: dirt on the mirror
kg-tkk4.summary: In the south, west of the roundabout going up to Manas (formerly Jalal-Abad), the mirror has varying amounts of dirt on it.

kg-u5jL.title: Landscape: some snow on the ground
kg-u5jL.summary: There is usually some snow on the ground, more the further north you go, and a huge mountain to the north. This stretch has the southern dirty mirror.

kg-v0fX.title: Road: well-kept road through dry mountains
kg-v0fX.summary: A side road with broken coverage, well maintained, through dry mountains with only grass and shrubs. One mountain to the west has little snow left, and mountains to the north look dark like silhouettes.

kg-vu1b.title: Poles: trees and poles painted white at the base
kg-vu1b.summary: Tree trunks and concrete poles are often painted white at the bottom.

kg-x8cG.hide: intro to a road section only, no learnable content
